narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously announce that the HahaTai channel hosts, Gary and Jani, have been selected as the official hosts for the 16th Golden Indie Music Awards. The video uses a fake street interview format to build suspense before the big reveal.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal announcement and graphic posters confirming the collaboration between HahaTai and GIMA.
